messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD#83472 — embeddings-queue-eu-west1. symptom=5xx spike, queue depth up, customers seeing timeouts. severity=P2. link: https://pd.redwood/incident/83472

pagerbot: Auto-assign -> @Alice (eng-oncall). Escalation policy: notify -> 5m then escalate.

Alice: ack — i'm on it. ping if you need me to hand off. :eyes:

Devon: i'm pulling logs now. quick q: are we seeing KV-cache evictions or a model rollout?

pagerbot: Metrics snapshot (1m): 5xx=12% ↑, queue_depth=84, tail_latency=1.2s. Recent deploy: model-embedder-v3 at 11:07 UTC. No autoscaler events in last 10m.

Mira: i'll take ownership for mitigation (handing off from Alice) — i'm free to coordinate infra. plan: 1) scale embed-pool-dedicated +2 GPUs, 2) enable fallback to quantized-model-v2 for low-priority, 3) bump autoscaler min replicas.

Alice: handing to Mira — pls post status every 5m and a short customer-impact note. i've DM'd support for comms.

Mira: kicking off scale now. running runbook command: `ops scale pool embed-pool-dedicated +2`

infra-bot: Job submitted -> scale request id=req-992, submitted by Mira. ETA ~90s.

Mira: applied fallback routing: `route embed-requests where priority!=high -> quantized-model-v2 (30%)`. monitoring effect.

Devon: saw a huge burst from cust-acme's batch job at 11:06 UTC — rate-limiter didn't block it. i'm throttling that job now.

support-bot: Support notified: cust-acme affected (~20% of their requests timed out). preparing customer note draft.

SRE-Lead: confirmed throttling of cust-acme at edge (80% reduction). continuing to watch metrics.

Mira: status (10m): scale complete, fallback in place, cust-acme throttled. 5xx down -> 3%, queue_depth -> 22, tail_latency -> 350ms. transferring PD ownership to Mira for follow-ups.

Alice: thanks — PD ownership transferred to Mira. i'll stay nearby for postmortem.

pagerbot: PD update: PD#83472 acknowledged, owner=Mira. next steps: monitor 30m, prepare short RCA if recurrence.

Mira: logged short incident summary in PD and created follow-up ticket INC-83472-FW. will post a brief postmortem if we see recurrence.

Alice: closing handover thread — good job everyone. :thumbsup:
